findings.issue: Token この is glossed 'nine' — completely wrong word; この is the demonstrative 'this' (here part of この頃 'these days'). Role is also null while other content tokens carry roles.
Token この is glossed 'nove' (the numeral nine) — wrong word; この is o demonstrativo 'este/esta', parte de この頃 'ultimamente'.
この頃 meaning 'lately/these days' is read このごろ (rendaku), not このころ; このころ refers to 'around that time' in narration. Romaji 'konokoro...' inherits the same error.
findings.current: このころにほんごのべんきょうがたのしい
findings.suggested: このごろにほんごのべんきょうがたのしい

findings.issue: Reading of 頃 in この頃 ('lately') should be ごろ (このごろ), not ころ; ころ without rendaku matches the 'around that time' sense, not the 'these days' sense used here.
中ぐらい ('about medium/intermediate', 中位) is standardly read ちゅうぐらい, not なかぐらい. Romaji '...madanakaguraidesu' inherits the same wrong reading.
findings.current: わたしのにほんごわまだなかぐらいです
findings.suggested: わたしのにほんごわまだちゅうぐらいです

findings.issue: Token 中 in 中ぐらい should be read ちゅう (中位 ちゅうぐらい = 'about medium'); なか is the wrong reading for this word in this context.

Literal translation renders conditional と as 'Because', a causal meaning と does not have here; the item's own expl correctly identifies と as conditional. The literal should mirror the if/when structure.
findings.current: Because there is no car, shopping is inconvenient.
findings.suggested: If there is no car, shopping is inconvenient.

findings.issue: Literal translation glosses かける as 'take', which is wrong; 鍵をかける is literally 'put/apply the key' (= lock), matching lit_pt 'ponho' and the token gloss.
findings.current: When leaving the house, as for the key, I take it.
findings.suggested: When leaving the house, as for the key, I put it (lock up).

findings.issue: Register mismatch: polite JP (不便です) rendered with informal Brazilian slang 'perrengue'; 不便 is neutral 'inconveniente'. Task convention requires neutral-polite pt for polite JP.
findings.current: Se você não tem carro, fazer compras é um perrengue.
findings.suggested: Se você não tem carro, fazer compras é inconveniente.

findings.issue: Internal authoring artifact '(alvo 1285)' (a target ID) leaked into the learner-facing pt explanation; absent from expl_en. Should be removed.
findings.current: A frase começa com この頃 (ultimamente), o foco de vocabulário (alvo 1285).
findings.suggested: A frase começa com この頃 (ultimamente), o foco de vocabulário.

findings.issue: In this restaurant context 注文 means 'order' (as en/pt/expl all say), not 'request'; 'request' fits another sense of the word. pt gloss 'pedido' is correct.
